item.title: Some Iranians fear the regime is now more entrenched - and ready for revenge
item.description: Ordinary Iranians tell of worry about increased repression by authorities after the war is over.

item.title: Bowen: Strait of Hormuz standoff raises risk of sliding back into all-out war
item.description: The US and Iran's determination to keep the pressure on each other has put the fragile Gulf ceasefire in serious jeopardy.

item.title: BBC traces how 10 minutes of Israeli bombing brought devastation to Lebanon
item.description: The bombs started falling at 14:15 in the afternoon - bringing chaos and destruction across the country.

item.title: Iran considering US proposal as Trump says war will be 'over quickly'
item.description: Mediator Pakistan says it is "endeavouring to convert this ceasefire into a permanent end to this war".

item.title: Trump says US to pause operation to guide vessels through Strait of Hormuz
item.description: "Project Freedom", which began on Monday, will be halted because progress has been made toward a deal with Iran, the US president says.

item.title: Trump pauses Hormuz plan 50 hours after he announced it - what happened?
item.description: The US president pauses the military operation to get ships through the Strait of Hormuz two days after he announced it.

item.title: Trump's hopes for an Iran peace deal come with caveats
item.description: There are signs of fresh momentum to end the war, but Trump himself has injected a note of caution.

item.title: Lebanon says Israeli strikes killed 39
item.description: Israel and Hezbollah have continued to trade fire despite a ceasefire deal being announced last month.

item.title: Israel deports two activists detained on board Gaza flotilla
item.description: Spanish national Saif Abu Keshek and Brazilian Thiago Ávila were detained by Israel after sailing in a Gaza-bound aid flotilla.

item.title: Iran sends response to US proposals to end war
item.description: No details have been released of Iran's response - or the US proposals - designed to bring the war to an end.
